final_message:
I implemented `parsePorts`, `normalizePorts` and `countPorts` in `src/ports.ts` as the README describes, and all 3 tests pass.

The tests don't exercise most of the error rules, so those were not run. These are empty items, non-digit input, reversed ranges like `90-80`, and a whitespace-only list returning no ports.
